prompts.chuheunFieldPrompt:
Create a production pixel-art game sprite atlas for Kang Chuheun, using the attached character sheet ONLY as character identity reference. Exactly 8 columns by 8 rows, 64 separate complete full-body sprites, on genuinely transparent background, square canvas. Equal uniform cells, no grid lines, no text, no labels, no props outside the cells. Every cell has generous empty padding; no sprite touches its cell edge. All characters the SAME scale and foot registration, not a contact sheet with varying zoom.
Art direction: Sea of Stars inspired premium hand-crafted pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, restrained 24-color shading, readable adult/teen proportions about 3.5 heads high, NOT tiny 2-head chibi, NOT smooth painted illustration. Preserve ash-gray tousled short hair, amber eyes, cheerful smiling expression, black Korean wrap top with rich cobalt-blue lapel/cuffs/hem, black tied belt, slim orange inner accent, loose black trousers, orange-and-white sneakers, navy steel chain wound around left wrist. No swords. NO new outfit.
Rows 1-8 are separate viewing directions, in this EXACT order: south/front, southwest/front-left 3/4, west/left profile, northwest/back-left 3/4, north/back, northeast/back-right 3/4, east/right profile, southeast/front-right 3/4. Do not substitute front views for diagonal/back views.
Within EVERY row columns 1-8 are: (1) standing relaxed smiling; (2) walking left foot forward right arm forward; (3) walking passing pose legs together; (4) walking right foot forward left arm forward; (5) running left foot forward strong knee lift and torso lean; (6) running right foot forward opposite stride; (7) chain windup coiling torso and pulling wrist back, cheerful eyes become visibly focused, mouth open determined grin; (8) chain release whole-body follow-through, arm thrust in the viewing direction, brows lowered with lively determined shout.
Walking/running poses must have distinct leg silhouettes, not copies shifted up and down. Rear directions have actual backs of clothing/hair. Draw only the short 3-link chain stub near the wrist, never long chains across cells; the engine animates the extending chain. Keep torso/limbs fully coherent in every cell. Output the entire 8x8 atlas with all 64 cells visible.

Leave clear padding between ALL cells and at canvas borders. Same proportions and scale in every cell, legs never cut off.
Match the premium Sea of Stars inspired crisp cluster pixel art of input 2, with carefully readable outlines and shaded cloth, NOT smooth anime painting. Yeonwoo: long straight black hair, small GOLD hair clip on her left bangs, AMBER/GOLD eyes, calm impassive face (NOT pink eyes or pink pin), black Korean wrap jacket with cobalt-blue lapel/cuffs/hem, black waist tie, subtle GOLD inner sash, plain black skirt with blue hem, black lace-up ankle boots. Each row's 8 columns: standing impassive; walking left foot forward; walking passing pose; walking right foot forward; running left foot forward with long hair flowing behind; running right foot forward opposite stride; chain preparation drawing wrist back with slight torso turn; chain snap wrist extended into viewing direction with firm neutral face and whole-body follow-through. All sprites grounded on their own consistent cell foot baseline. Exactly 64 sprites, eight full rows with generous bottom padding.
prompts.chuheunBattlePrompt:
Production sprite atlas for Kang Chuheun for a turn-based pixel-art JRPG. Reference attached sheet is authoritative identity. EXACTLY 6 columns and 4 rows, 24 whole-body sprites, transparent background, evenly spaced equal square cells, generous clear margins including bottom. NO text/grid/frames. All sprites face RIGHT in consistent three-quarter battle view, same size, same ground baseline; each sprite self-contained.
Style: beautiful Sea of Stars inspired hand-drawn PIXEL ART, crisp blocky color clusters, dark selective outline, rich restrained shaded palette, about FOUR heads tall, expressive amber eyes and smiling mouth visibly readable. Not vector/anime painting, not 2-head chibi. Preserve tousled ash gray hair, black Korean wrap jacket with cobalt blue edges and cuffs, orange inner accent, loose black trousers, orange/white sneakers, navy steel left-wrist chain.
Row 1 SIX consecutive quiet idle animation frames: relaxed cheerful smile, slight breathing chest rise, soft hair shift, relaxed arms with small chain hanging from wrist, gentle weight transfer, a blink on frame 4 then smile. Do NOT change outfit/pose radically; form a seamless loop.
Row 2 SIX consecutive normal-attack frames: prepare smiling -> pull left wrist back -> raise chain hand overhead as a lasso -> rotate overhead with a lively concentrated grin -> snap forward toward the right with determined open mouth -> extended follow-through. Short chain only near wrist; long weapon trajectory will be engine drawn.
Row 3 SIX combat states: settle back after attack; braced guard with forearms crossed; recoil from hit; focused energy-gathering hands; left arm raised holding a cobalt chain-spear shaft above shoulder; overhead spear thrust to the right. Shaft stays inside cell, no huge effects.
Row 4 SIX personality/special states: cheerful arm stretch; embarrassed grin scratching cheek; holding an opened blue soda can near mouth; biting a sandwich; fast forward dash silhouette; exhausted kneeling downed pose. All retain same character and outfit. Fully visible head/hair/feet, no motion blur, no background, no gigantic energy flashes.
